**CDIF**
Definition ==========
Role given to a represented variable in the context of a dimensional data structure to identify the universes associated with data points. The variable acts as a field in the compound identifier (the key structure) to disambiguate the cells in the multi-dimensional "cube". AG: references to the variables which are the components of a compound identifier, in which each variable is a single field - an axis - in a coordinate system addressing a location in a matrix. These variables are often categorical, but also commonly include time. Unlike other Components, they may be ordered using instances of cdi:ComponentPosition. :idDescription: "Identifier for this DimensionComponent node" :rdfType: ``cdi:DimensionComponent`` :exportedDef:

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
Variable that provides codes for variable identification in the context of a data structure. Descriptor Variables hold values which reference the logical variables in the data set, indicating which one the associated value in the corresponding Reference Variable is a measure/value for. Descriptor Variables are presentational variables found only in Long Data Sets. :inlineOrByReference: ``inline`` :jsonName: "cdif:isDefinedBy_DescriptorVariable"
